column1: # Release wheel matrix. Each non-comment row is one wheel build.
# Compatibility policy follows the official Ascend/PyTorch compatibility table.
#   CANN 9.2 / torch 2.12: Python 3.10, 3.11, and 3.12; beta support is provisional.
# CANN 8.5 builds only the 910 backend. CANN 9.0 and later build 910 and 950
# independently on aarch64 and x86_64. The release workflow runs in the
# pre-provisioned fa-npu-matrix:<arch> image and activates the Conda environment
# matching py_tag, torch_ver, and the exact CANN patch version in base_image.
# The base_image and torch_npu_release columns document the original stack;
# release jobs do not pull or build them. A nonempty image field overrides the
# Additional CANN 9.0-9.2 host CPU / NPU combinations
